captions.FB:
Meet Dr Sara Hamilton, Clinical Director at the Bariatric Counseling Center.

Dr Hamilton is a clinical psychologist who leads our behavioral therapy programming. She works with clients one-on-one and in group sessions, helping them understand and modify their relationship with food.

What she wants every new client to know: "You're not broken. You're learning a new way to relate to food, and that takes practice."

Dr Hamilton is part of our experienced and compassionate team of behavioral healthcare professionals serving clients in San Antonio and virtual across Texas.

Link in the first comment.
captions.IG:
Clinical psychologist Dr Sara Hamilton

Dr Sara Hamilton is the Clinical Director at the Bariatric Counseling Center. As a clinical psychologist, she leads our behavioral therapy programming for people who struggle with weight-loss, obesity, binge eating, and chronic over-eating.

Dr Hamilton works with clients in individual sessions and group therapy, helping them develop recovery and coping skills. Her approach centers on understanding patterns and building sustainable change.

What she wants every new client to know in week one: "You're not broken. You're learning a new way to relate to food, and that takes practice."

Our team serves clients in San Antonio and virtual across Texas.
